compatibility_decision: additive only on V1-frozen symbols (2026-09-16, repository owner)
what_was_already_seen: the audit agent's reproductions: a record whose only passing checks establish DIMENSIONALLY_VALID, NUMERICALLY_CONVERGED or ANALYTICALLY_VERIFIED derives SUPPORTED; a report of one PASS and one NOT_RUN check has status PASS; an OK evaluation accepts a result with UNKNOWN validity, a NOT_ASSESSED model, or no model

a survey of src/: domains establish mostly verification levels (NUMERICALLY_CONVERGED 10 sites, DIMENSIONALLY_VALID 8, ANALYTICALLY_VERIFIED 6) against CROSS_SOLVER_VALIDATED 6, BENCHMARK_VALIDATED 1, EXPERIMENTALLY_VALIDATED 1
a scan of every committed JSON: no stored report pairs status pass or warning with a not_run check

evidence_basis.rule: verification levels are DIMENSIONALLY_VALID, NUMERICALLY_CONVERGED and ANALYTICALLY_VERIFIED; validation levels are BENCHMARK_VALIDATED, CROSS_SOLVER_VALIDATED and EXPERIMENTALLY_VALIDATED. A report's evidence basis is VALIDATED when it attains a validation level, VERIFICATION_ONLY when it attains only verification levels, NONE when it attains none
evidence_basis.where: ValidationReport.evidence_basis (derived) and the credibility report's verdict_qualifiers.evidence_basis (derived, re-derived on read)
evidence_basis.verdict: NOT changed. SUPPORTED on verification alone stays SUPPORTED, with the qualifier saying so on every report
evidence_basis.why_not_change_the_verdict: most domains earn only verification levels, so the verdict word moves the scored benchmarks and their sealed hold-out; that is a separate decision for the repository owner, recorded as the residual. The qualifier makes the distinction unmissable in every serialized report without it

report_status_precedence.rule: ValidationReport.status is FAIL if any check failed, else NOT_RUN if any check did not run, else WARNING if any warned, else PASS; an empty report is NOT_RUN
report_status_precedence.was: FAIL > WARNING > PASS > NOT_RUN, so one PASS outvoted an experimental comparison that never ran
report_status_precedence.effect_on_usability: none: is_usable and trusted execution read status is not FAIL

established_candidates.rule: Experiment.best ranks only OK evaluations whose result names at least one model, every one assessed IN_DOMAIN, and whose constraints were checked and satisfied when the experiment declares constraints. An evaluation whose feasibility is unchecked, whose validity is UNKNOWN, or whose result names no model is not a candidate for best
established_candidates.not_changed: which evaluations may be recorded as OK: OK still means usable values, and an experiment still records every attempt

what_will_be_reported_after_implementati: every batch-3a regression test, seen failing on the baseline commit and passing after
every existing assertion that changes, with the reason, including any domain study or benchmark whose best candidate changes
amendments: recorded here as dated entries, never edited in place
